resources.string: Scan the QR or paste the bunker:// URI shown by Sapwood\'s Connect an app flow.
Point the camera at the QR shown by Sapwood.
Camera access was declined. Pasting the bunker link above still works.
Cambium will forget this signer. Apps bound to it will stop working until you pair it again.
Cambium will forget every paired signer and every app\'s permissions. Apps will stop working until you pair again.
Runs a background service so signing stays fast. Uses a small amount of battery. Off by default.
Shows while Cambium keeps the connection to your Heartwood warm in the background.
Keeping the connection to your signer warm.
Notification access was declined. The connection can still be kept warm without one, but Android may stop the background service sooner.
Heartwood\'s own policy still decides what actually gets signed.
Website requests are approved once. Cambium never grants permission to the whole browser.
What Cambium has done on your behalf. Timestamp, app, request and identity only: never a payload, a plaintext or a ciphertext.
This removes every entry from this device. It does not change anything about your paired signers or connected apps.
Require your device unlock (fingerprint, face or PIN) to open Cambium and approve requests. Off by default.
No screen lock is set up on this device. Set one in system settings to use app lock.
Cambium is not paired with a signer.
Cambium is busy. Please try again.
The signer did not respond in time.
The website sent an invalid NIP-55 request.
The signer returned an invalid event.
No app can open the website callback.
Signer result copied to the clipboard.
Listening for your Heartwood\'s unlock requests.
A Heartwood that restarted locked and is asking this phone to unlock it.
A paired signer has stopped answering, or is still locked after an unlock.
This also appears if someone else powers the board on. Only unlock if you expect it.
No current request from this board. While it is locked it asks every minute, and this screen updates when it does.
firmware %1$s, access point %2$s, asked %3$d s ago

This phone\'s unlock key for the board is gone, usually because a fingerprint or face was added to the phone, or its screen lock was removed. Forget the board here, revoke its record in Sapwood, and set up phone unlock again.
Sent. The board shows \"Unlocked by\" on its screen within a few seconds. If it is still locked in a minute, Cambium tells you.
No relay accepted the unlock. Check this phone\'s connection and try again; the board keeps asking every minute.
This board is no longer set up for phone unlock.
It kept asking after this phone answered. Its record for this phone may have been revoked. Unlock it from Sapwood, or set up phone unlock again.
No answer to the last two scheduled checks. A power cut or a network problem at the board? If it restarts locked, Cambium asks you to unlock it.
A Heartwood is asking to be unlocked.
The board restarted again while you were confirming, so nothing was sent. Check the new request below.
Two different answers arrived for this code (records %1$d and %2$d), so someone else has seen it. Nothing was kept on this phone. Revoke both records in Sapwood and start again with a new code.

A second, different answer arrived (record %2$d) after this phone kept record %1$d, so someone else has seen the code. Forget this board below, revoke both records in Sapwood, and start again with a new code.
The answer names record %1$d, which this phone already holds. Nothing was changed. Start again with a new code.
Not confirmed in time, so the unlock key was dropped. Revoke record %1$d in Sapwood and start again.
After a restart, these boards can ask this phone to unlock them. Cambium keeps listening while any are set up here.
This phone will no longer be able to unlock the board. The board still has record %1$d for this phone: revoke it in Sapwood or over USB, so the key cannot be used by a copy of this phone.
Allow Cambium to run in the background
On Sapwood, click \"Add a phone\", then scan its code with this phone. Nothing secret is in the code, and nothing secret passes through Sapwood.
Camera permission is needed to scan. Use \"Show a code instead\" below.
If Sapwood cannot scan or does not offer this, show this phone\'s own code instead: add it in Sapwood under \"Phones that can unlock\", then press the button on the board.
Your signer will show these five words. Hold its button only if they match; it shows the check code after you hold it.
Sending this phone\'s answer to Sapwood…
No relay accepted the answer. Check this phone\'s connection and retry.
Waiting for the board… If it says it added this phone but nothing arrives here, revoke the id it shows in Sapwood.
The board added this phone. Check that the board shows the same six characters, then confirm with your phone\'s screen lock to keep the unlock key on this phone.
Keep the unlock key on this phone
Not confirmed yet. Confirm to finish; if you leave now, revoke record %1$d on the board in Sapwood.
This phone could not create a key for it: %1$s
Done. This phone can unlock the board (record %1$d). Cambium now listens for it in the background.
Phone unlock needs a screen lock on this phone (a PIN, pattern or password; on Android 10 and older, a fingerprint or face unlock of the strong class), because it is what releases the unlock key.
This pairing has no relays Cambium can use.
